name: The Bouncer
description: Sweet-talk or slip past the muscle on the door.
failure_consequence: The door staff start remembering faces.
success_bonus: The crew walks in as guests.
critical_success_reward: He waves the whole crew through without a look.
critical_failure_effect: He calls it in, and the room gets watchful.

name: Cloakroom Cabinet
description: A cheap cabinet holding better things than it should.
failure_consequence: The lock jams, and the attendant returns early.

name: Back Alley Exit
description: Out through the service door and into the delivery lane.
failure_consequence: A kitchen hand watches the crew leave.

name: Counting Room
description: The night's take, still in the trays.
failure_consequence: The tray alarm trips and the floor manager is paged.
critical_success_reward: The float is untouched and unrecorded.

name: Camera Bank
description: Blind the watchful electronic eyes, briefly.
failure_consequence: Security notices a gap in the feed and starts a sweep.
critical_success_reward: The whole floor's coverage loops for the run.

name: Night Patrol
description: Two guards, one route, and eleven predictable minutes.
failure_consequence: A guard turns early and the crew has to move loudly.
critical_failure_effect: The patrol calls in an unscheduled check.

name: Main Vault Door
description: Open the steel with finesse, before the time lock notices.
failure_consequence: The time-lock alarm trips and the response clock starts.
critical_success_reward: The door opens clean, and quietly, and early.

name: Laser Grid
description: Dance through the web of beams across the gallery floor.
failure_consequence: A beam breaks, and a silent alarm starts a clock.
critical_failure_effect: The gallery shutters begin to close.

name: The Night Curator
description: Convince a cultured insomniac that you belong here.
failure_consequence: He is polite, and then he calls the desk.

name: Pressure-Sensitive Case
description: Lift the piece without letting the plate know it left.
failure_consequence: The case alarm carries through the whole wing.
critical_success_reward: The swap is perfect; nobody looks for days.

name: Executive Elevator
description: Talk the lift controller into the floors it protects.
failure_consequence: The car locks out and the stairwell is the only way up.

name: Penthouse Safe
description: A private safe, bought for looks and installed for it too.
failure_consequence: The secondary system arms and cannot be disarmed twice.
critical_success_reward: There is more in it than the file said.

name: Board Room Crossing
description: Cross a glass room that was designed to be looked into.
failure_consequence: A late executive sees movement and is not sure enough to shout.

name: Loading Dock
description: Over the roller door before the shift bell.
failure_consequence: A dropped crate brings the dock foreman out.

name: Server Cage
description: A locked rack, a hot aisle, and a very short window.
failure_consequence: The intrusion is logged, and logs are read on Mondays.
critical_success_reward: The logs are rewritten as a maintenance window.

name: Reception Desk
description: Sign in as somebody the building expects.
failure_consequence: The visitor log now has a face and a bad name on it.

name: Roof Approach
description: Four storeys of service ladder and one bad parapet.
failure_consequence: A fall, a noise, and a very long minute of standing still.

name: The Dog Run
description: Two shepherds who take their work more seriously than the guards.
failure_consequence: Barking, and lights coming on in the yard office.

name: Armed Response
description: Two contractors, alerted, and between the crew and the street.
failure_consequence: Somebody gets hurt, and somebody makes a statement.
critical_failure_effect: The response calls for backup on an open channel.

name: Skylight Drop
description: Eleven metres of controlled descent onto a marble floor.
failure_consequence: A hard landing, a loud one, and a turned ankle.
critical_success_reward: The line is set for the way out as well.

name: The Auction Floor
description: Bid, be seen, and be the reason nobody watches the back.
failure_consequence: A dealer recognises the face and mentions it to the house.
critical_success_reward: The house treats the crew as a client for the night.

name: Biometric Door
description: Two factors, one of which is a person who went home at six.
failure_consequence: A failed read locks the door for an hour and files a ticket.

name: The Deposit Boxes
description: Four hundred small locks, and only nine that matter.
failure_consequence: A drilled box is obvious by morning and traceable by noon.
critical_success_reward: Nine boxes open, and a tenth that looked interesting.

name: The Harbour Fence
description: A lit yard, a patrolled line, and water on three sides.
failure_consequence: A spotlight finds the line, and the yard wakes up.

name: Sweep Team
description: The alarm brought people, and the people brought torches.
failure_consequence: The sweep finds the crew's route and follows it.

name: Responding Unit
description: Somebody called it in, and somebody came.
failure_consequence: An arrest is attempted, and it goes badly for everyone.

name: Lockdown Shutter
description: The building decided to close around the crew.
failure_consequence: The shutter stays down and the way out gets longer.

name: Panicked Witness
description: A cleaner who was not supposed to be on this floor.
failure_consequence: They run, and they talk, and they are believed.
